versions.changelog:
- Removed manual installation instructions referencing `references/manual-install.md`.
- Updated installation section: now directs users to download binaries from the GitHub releases page for manual installation.
- Added a note linking to the Speechall API key creation page in the authentication section.
- No functional CLI changes. Documentation only.

Initial public release of speechall-cli:

- Provides a command-line tool for fast speech-to-text transcription using multiple providers.
- Supports audio and video input, speaker diarization, subtitles, custom vocabularies, and more.
- Offers easy installation via Homebrew (macOS/Linux) and manual instructions.
- Includes commands to transcribe files and list/filter supported STT models with various options.
- API key-based authentication required; flexible via env var or CLI flag.
